ports.scope_rules: Every document and chunk operation is tenant_id + workspace_id scoped; typed absence must not widen scope.
ports.transaction_participation: Required participant in ingestion reservation, bounded chunk commit, publication, and lifecycle tombstone transactions; current chunk UnitOfWork is not a real transaction.

ports.scope_rules: Canonical facts and source contributions require tenant/workspace/revision keys; names alone are never authority.
ports.transaction_participation: Canonical fact revisions belong to the relational ingestion/lifecycle commit; AGE projection delivery is asynchronous and receipt-tracked.

ports.production_constructor: AppState::new_postgres -> PgVectorStorage/PgWorkspaceVectorRegistry; typed indexes are assembled by PostgreSQL ingestion services
ports.scope_rules: Mandatory tenant/workspace, family, model revision, content revision, document and visibility predicates execute before candidate return.
ports.transaction_participation: Embedding manifests are committed with relational authority; physical vector writes are projection deliveries except for current co-located compatibility paths.

ports.production_constructor: AppState::new_postgres -> document_read_model and serving-fence query helpers
ports.scope_rules: Batch current-state checks require exact tenant/workspace/document/revision identity; pending, stale, deleted, or foreign rows are non-serving.
ports.transaction_participation: Visibility publication and revocation must commit atomically with authority revision and durable delivery intents.

ports.production_constructor: AppState::new_postgres -> PostgresRuntime pool consumed by services/identity_storage.rs
ports.scope_rules: User identity is globally unique where declared; authorization always resolves tenant/workspace membership before constructing access scope.
ports.transaction_participation: Credential, lockout, role, and bootstrap membership changes require adapter-local transactions; currently implemented as direct policy-layer SQL calls.

existing_trait: No injectable port; session_storage functions and auth DTO records
ports.production_constructor: Auth handlers receive StorageRuntime/PostgresRuntime and call services/session_storage.rs
ports.scope_rules: Refresh tokens and API keys bind to a user and authorized tenant/workspace context; revocation must survive restart.
ports.transaction_participation: Issue/revoke/rotate operations require atomic credential state transitions; current direct SQL operations are individually committed.

ports.scope_rules: Workspace lookup is tenant-bound; membership grants/revokes precede access-scope construction and same-name workspaces may coexist across tenants.
ports.transaction_participation: Tenant/workspace creation, membership, quota, and default provisioning use relational transactions where multi-row invariants apply.

ports.production_constructor: AppState::new_postgres -> ConversationServiceImpl::new(pool); PostgresConversationStorage is available behind the storage port
ports.scope_rules: Conversation and message reads/writes require tenant/workspace/user ownership and stable ordered pagination.
ports.transaction_participation: Conversation/message append and metadata updates require adapter-local transactions for multi-row operations.

ports.scope_rules: Task payload and status remain tenant/workspace scoped; claim ownership uses worker identity, lease epoch, and fencing.
ports.transaction_participation: Enqueue, claim, renew, terminal transition, cancellation, and fairness counters require atomic compare-and-update semantics.

ports.scope_rules: Reservations are keyed by provider role plus tenant/workspace fairness identity; one scope cannot consume another scope's reservation.
ports.transaction_participation: Acquire, renew, release, and expiry reclamation require atomic slot accounting and fencing.

existing_trait: No unified port; pipeline checkpoint and artifact retrieval services
ports.production_constructor: DocumentTaskProcessor and artifact handlers consume PostgresRuntime/StorageRuntime
ports.scope_rules: Checkpoint and artifact keys include tenant/workspace/document/task/revision; provider error is distinct from absence.
ports.transaction_participation: Checkpoint advancement is conditional on task lease/revision; artifact manifests publish only after all required blobs are durable.

ports.scope_rules: Blob and layout access requires tenant/workspace/document ownership; checksums and page/asset identities are immutable within a content revision.
ports.transaction_participation: Metadata and publication state participate in document commit; large bytes may stage separately but remain non-serving until manifest publication.

ports.production_constructor: edgequake migrate and AppState PostgreSQL bootstrap construct migration engine access from admin_pool
ports.scope_rules: Schema migrations are provider-wide administrative operations; data movement jobs retain source/target binding, partition, and scope checkpoints.
ports.transaction_participation: Each migration page and checkpoint update is idempotent and fenced; schema application remains an explicit operator transaction sequence.

existing_trait: OutboxSink; no complete per-target ProjectionLedger port
ports.production_constructor: Ingestion persistence creates PostgresOutboxSink; API outbox drain consumes PostgreSQL rows
ports.scope_rules: Events carry tenant/workspace, authority revision, target binding generation, schema version, and immutable operation identity.
ports.transaction_participation: Event append is required in the authority commit; claim/lease/ack/retry/quarantine are fenced ledger transactions.

existing_trait: AuditLogger concrete service; no storage trait
ports.scope_rules: Security events retain actor, tenant/workspace when applicable, action, outcome, and immutable timestamp; query authorization is administrative.
ports.transaction_participation: Audit append is durable and immutable; security-critical authority changes must define whether audit failure aborts or records an explicit recovery obligation.
